owner_policy_unchanged: Default-on adding on every independently eligible Amex and Chase card. Matching merchants or text do not suppress another eligible card.

paraphrased_rules: Added offers cannot be removed; no published limit on number added.
Offers are selected per card; redemption uses that same card.
Primary cardmembers and authorizing officers can add credit-card offers; authorized users and employees cannot.
Wallet distinguishes Added, Redeemed and Expired; redeemed/expired history lasts 90 days.
implementation_consequences: Pause stops future actions without promising removal.
Card visibility alone does not establish authority to activate offers.
Issuer history disappearance does not prove an action never succeeded; retain the local action ledger.
A per-card offer is not proof of cross-card campaign exclusivity.

amex.access: Direct official-page opens failed. Official search-index excerpts with different crawl dates are not a verified current full terms document.
amex.consequence: Reverify current applicable offer/cardmember restrictions before enabling an action adapter. Do not infer either universal multi-card eligibility or a universal single-card policy from unavailable pages or matching text.
